title: Switching routes after a scare
hook: Two stated cases: explore the expected risk of both available routes.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the expected risk of both available routes affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Difference, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the expected risk of both available routes in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
